title: New Moon: Collective Healing — Embodied Peace Practice
description: A 90-minute online session from Transition Network's Inner and Cultural Transformation circle, using the new moon as a moment to pause and turn inward. This one treats peace as a practice rather than an ideal — how we meet difference, listen, repair, and hold many perspectives — with Austrian peace researcher and intercultural conflict-transformation facilitator Julia Thandiwe Felder. In English with subtitles; sign up on the session page. 17:00-18:30 UTC.
